message.content:
**When the pain started**  
The pain began the night my catheter stopped working. I noticed it right after the urine output dropped, so it’s been about 12‑14 hours now. It feels like a constant, deep ache in the lower part of my belly. I would rate it around an 8 out of 10. It doesn’t really come and go – it’s there all the time, and it gets a little worse when I try to move or take a deep breath.

**What kind of catheter it was and what happened**  
I have an indwelling catheter that sits in my continent MAINZ pouch I (the urinary diversion I had after my bladder was removed). I’ve been having more and more trouble putting the catheter in for the past few weeks, so the doctors put this permanent catheter in to drain the pouch continuously. Last night the catheter stopped draining – the urine flow slowed down a lot and then basically stopped. Because the pouch wasn’t emptying, I started feeling the severe belly pain and my breathing got harder.
